test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 19 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A certain sum, when invested for 2 years at 12% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, amounts to Rs. 39,200. Find the sum invested (in Rs.).
solution:
**Given:**

Amount = 39200

Rate = 12%

Time = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount = Principal × (1 + R ÷ 100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

⇒ 39200 = P × (1 + 12 ÷ 100)²

⇒ 39200 = P × (112 ÷ 100)²

⇒ 39200 = P × (12544 ÷ 10000)

⇒ P = 39200 × (10000 ÷ 12544)

⇒ P = 31250

**∴ The correct answer is 31250.**
